mission: We study efficient methods for managing scientific data on high-performance computing systems, with a focus on data reduction, compression, and parallel and distributed systems.

research.title: Data reduction & compression
research.description: Compression quality prediction and configuration selection for scientific datasets.

research.title: Scientific data management
research.description: Progressive retrieval and efficient access to large scientific datasets.

research.title: Parallel & distributed systems
research.description: Performance modeling and data movement across modern computing and storage systems.

recruiting: We welcome inquiries from students interested in high-performance computing and scientific data management.
